pretty_print_predicate: use pretty() to format a geometry DSL predicate string into its compact symbolic representation
natural_language_format_predicate: use pretty_nl() to convert a geometry predicate name and args into a human-readable natural language sentence
format_angle_notation: use pretty_angle() to format four point labels into a canonical angle notation string with the angle symbol
simplify_fraction: use simplify() to reduce a numerator and denominator to their lowest terms by dividing by their GCD
map_dsl_symbol: use map_symbol() and map_symbol_inv() to convert between single-character DSL symbols and their full predicate names
